title: Adding theme switch to every page
summary: Implemented a theme switch for every page that persists user's choice using localStorage.
content: This feature provides the ability to switch between light or dark colours when viewing the pages. The hint was very helpful to determine that localStorage keeps the last theme that was set by the user. My biggest challenge was trying to determine a good colour pallete for the light version of my page as I already started with the dark version. In the end I chose the hex opposite of my dark colours and implemented some blue for contrast.

title: Created dynamic blog section
summary: Created a dynamic blog section that loads from a JSON file
content: This feature loads post content from a JSON file and dynamically displays it on the blog page. The biggest challenge I came across was formatting the cards that contain blog details using Bootstrap. Fortunately, by playing around with the sizes and positions, I was able to format the content in a decent manner. Also, I couldn't figure out why my date was a day behind until I found out that the Date object's .toLocaleDateString formats local time to UTC. However, the solution was quite simple, I just had to add a local time T12:00:00, which forces JavaScript to format UTC into my local timezone

title: Built contact form validation
summary: Created a validation js to check contact form fields
content: This feature will show whether the correct values have been inputted or not for each field. The biggest challenge I came across was not being able to identify why my error messages weren't showing up when the fields were empty. Thankfully, I discovered that value.trim() removes extra spaces and prevents a form from looking like it is filled when it is empty.

title: Added filter for project and blog pages
summary: Added category buttons for filtering project page and blog post page
content: This feature provides category buttons that filter the specific project/blog post when clicked. The biggest challenge I had with this part was that I couldn't get the category buttons to show the specific card. Funny enough, the solution was just simply adding ids to the card column in each of their divs.
